author: Wahiz
body:
Hey.

IN_THE_CODE

I was banned because i had to many infractions and i didn't learn my lesson when i was temp banned and i also have been bad evading alot which i didnt think about that much when i started doing.

If changed a lot since i played on avicus and i just want a second chance because this time i promise to follow the rules be kind and show respect to every single player and staff member i meet.

My ban was not false because i know i was mean to people and have broken the rules and i will admit that.

The time i have spent away from avicus made me think about how i should change and clean my act up.

Yes I have been caught ban evading but i just did it so i can see old friends and to see  how the comunity was doing.

I have appealed before this but the first ones were bad and not written well and i di them to early

Please Sr Mods Think About This

-IN_THE_CODE

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

I would appealed you, considering that this infraction is rather old. However, you have been caught ban evading many times. This makes me doubt your statements. And in general, we don't appeal people who excessively ban evade. I am sorry, but you will not be appealed.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
